original.target_description: Study 1, explicit shame, main effect of moral beliefs (low versus high) in public exposure × moral beliefs × gender ANOVA.

n.exclusions: Analytic sample size not explicitly established for this test.

replication.target_description: Direct replication, explicit shame, main effect of moral beliefs (high versus low) in two-way ANOVA, scenarios pooled.

n.sample_role: Final complete post-exclusion participants across both moral-belief levels and all exposure/scenario conditions in full-sample ANOVA.
n.exclusions: 1309 recruited; final completers after exclusion explicitly N=1272. General criteria address English proficiency, seriousness, previous survey exposure, incomplete response, US eligibility and age. Per-criterion exclusion counts not given; forced responses used.
n.location: p. 6 Participants; p. 11 two-way ANOVAs; supplementary p. 16 Missing or Incomplete data

notes:
Replication source is the final 2023 Collabra publication deposited in the assigned OSF project, with the matching title and study; author order and year differ from the supplied 2022 reference. Reported success records the authors’ overall study verdict, not an inferred verdict for this individual statistic. Original recruited sample (87 female and 81 male) is not substituted for analytic N: reported error df 154 leave test-specific inclusion unclear. Extracted the moral-belief main effect on explicit shame on both sides; retained printed F for the original and printed partial eta squared for the replication.
Completion source review (n_r): Printed final complete post-exclusion sample covers both levels of the full-sample moral-belief comparison; forced response documented. No N inferred from df.
